title: IT-01 IT
summary: Information technology cost centre IT-01 in unit NBC-MAN-01 owned by RPRYCE, with £499,322.74 available budget for 2026-Q4.
body:
Cost centre IT-01 covers Information Technology operations at Northbridge Cycles under business unit NBC-MAN-01[^r1]. As of 26 October 2026, the cost centre is OPEN under the ownership of RPRYCE[^r1]. For 2026-Q4, it has an allocated budget of £810,000, with £310,677.26 committed spend and £499,322.74 remaining available[^r2].

## Cost centre details

Cost centre IT-01 is an active operating cost centre within unit NBC-MAN-01 under owner RPRYCE[^r1]. Master definitions and budget balances are maintained in [[data-cost-centres-and-budgets|Cost Centres and Budgets FY2026-27]][^r1][^r2].

## Budget and commitments

For the 2026-Q4 period as of 26 October 2026 09:00:
* Budget amount: £810,000[^r2]
* Committed spend: £310,677.26[^r2]
* Available budget: £499,322.74[^r2]
